verdict.rationale: Ramp ships in-product AI agents (Ramp Intelligence), so letting users connect external MCP servers for those agents to use is a fair question. The evidence only documents Ramp acting as an MCP server: Ramp MCP, Developer MCP and Ramp Data MCP that outside assistants like Claude and ChatGPT connect to. That is the opposite role and does not transfer to this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows Ramp's own agents consuming tools from user-supplied MCP servers.
